Interface Renderable

All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<Renderable>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AnimatedEntity, Entity, FloorTile, OccludingEntity
public interface Renderable extends Comparable<Renderable>
Defines an object that can be positioned and rendered in an isometric scene.
